incidents.name: MIMSpell3
incidents.notes: Abracadabra cauldron cook() REPAY action accounting flaw let the attacker withdraw MIM from BentoBox across cauldrons without real repayment.

sources.ref: deployment-basis recheck: the cauldron's 45-byte runtime is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy whose master 0x5e70f7acb8ec0231c00220d11c74dc2b23187103 is encoded in the bytecode and cannot be repointed; callTracer confirms the exploit's cook() call (selector 0x656f3d64) delegatecalls that master. The clone runtime is byte-identical at the creation block 19477071 and the incident block 23504546. Deployment is exact; 562.9 days.
